item.description: 1. What Problem Argo CD Solves 1.1 Starting from GitOps GitOps originated from a blog post published by Weaveworks in 2017: GitOps - Operations by Pull Request. In it, Alexis introduced a deployment approach that treats Git as the single source of truth. In GitOps practice, we need to define software infrastructure in a Git repository for management.
